title: Offline-Online Metric Divergence:
prompt: **Offline-Online Metric Divergence:** Your new ranking model improved offline NDCG@10 by +3.5%, but in the live A/B test, revenue and engagement dropped by 1.2%. Give 7 distinct root causes (e.g., train-serve feature skew, latency increase causing client timeouts, position/selection bias in historical logs, lack of exploration/diversity, uncalibrated probabilities breaking downstream auction logic, stale embeddings, feedback loop cannibalization).
